texts.zh:
一艘载满了来自[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡侍僧的运输船同我们进行了联络。他们称自己为“变革派”，要求在我们的某颗星球上进行难民庇护。

这一事件意味着虚境行者内部发生了前所未有的大分裂。看来，太空城邦也没有我们想象中的那么团结。
texts.en:
We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.

This represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.

label.zh: 异种在我国境内没有容身之地。
label.en: Xenos have no place inside our borders.

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们收到消息，听说我们的一些前侍僧已经作为难民在你的星球安顿下来。这一作为让我们极其不悦，但就这样吧。鲁莽的行动一般都会导致绝望的后果。但是要记住这点：这些改革派不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒，一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。庇护这群异端会让你冒风险。那些居住在虚境里的存在肯定会注意到这件事。”
texts.en: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."

texts.zh:
“我们的恩主！在其他那么多世界置我们生死于不顾的时候，是你为我们提供了庇护……虚境一定会保佑你的，不论是此世还是彼世。我们的前同胞，[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]被传统遮蔽了双眼。虚境并非是不可渗透的。它存在一扇门，而我们发现了它的钥匙。

为了报答你的慷慨，我们愿意同你分享这个秘密。我们唯一要求的就是开工建设所需要的物资。”
texts.en:
"Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.

In reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."

texts.zh:
“虚境惊诧！有了贵方的帮助，我们最终完成了大钥匙的建设。现在，我们最有天赋的同胞聚集在一起准备将其打开。随着他们的意识同钥匙连接在一起，他们的灵能能力得到了强化。此刻，这些勇敢的朝圣者进入了一个共享类梦境状态。当他们苏醒的时候，一扇前往虚境的大门就会打开。

愿那些居住的虚境中的存在为他们的努力赐福。”
texts.en:
"The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.

May those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."

texts.zh: 令人担忧的消息自我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来：尽管缺乏资源，某些狂热的改革分子依然试图自己锻造了钥匙。他们使用临时替代装置增强自己的灵能能力，进入了共享类梦境状态。这一举动造成了殖民地中心城市的上方出现了一个时空裂口。有毒的、诱发焦虑的烟气瞬间灌了出来，看上去是来自虚境本身。许多人将这一现象称之为“虚境恶臭”，并且我们被告知这样的体验并不愉悦。[Root.GetName]的民心普遍的降低了。
texts.en: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了令人难以置信的好消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道靓丽的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似强风的存在涌了出来，奶白色的亮光将天空渲染得五颜六色。刮过殖民地的灵能共振透过了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黄金时代”的黎明。
texts.en: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了灾难般的坏消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道破败的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似纱雾的存在涌了出来，邪恶的亮光将天空渲染得十分瘆人。刮过殖民地的灵能瘴气扭曲了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黑暗时代”的开端。
texts.en: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们已经收到消息，你拒绝了我们的前侍僧在你的国境内寻求庇护的请求。你做的很明智。这些‘改革派’不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒；一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。任何决定庇护这群异端的团体都会冒风险。就让他们在太空中飘荡吧，无家可归，无心无肺，永远被此世和彼世遗忘。”
texts.en: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."
